motion.purpose: Search start; the big burst marks a locked match.

motion.name: tab-bounce
motion.purpose: Tab icon bounce after a tap.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Every animation above is switched off.

narrative.northStar: One Rose in a Dark Room
narrative.overview:
RandomChatly is a simple warm dark app, opened on a phone, late, in bed, with the lights off. There is no metaphor and no costume. Warmth comes from two things only: a stepped plum ground that every surface is cut from, and one rose colour that marks what you can do next. Everything else is quiet: warm white text, 1px hairlines, pill buttons, line icons in one muted tone.

Density is low and thumb-led. The Match tab puts one question and one rose pill in reach; searching turns the whole tab into a centred stage sized to the screen, so Cancel never needs a scroll. Motion is the one place the system lets itself be tender: a beating avatar, drifting heart outlines, a phrase that rises in word by word, and a set of one-shot moments that answer the user's own taps. Nothing moves on its own outside the search stage and the chat's opening heart.

The world refuses glassy purple-neon gradients and swipe-card dating clichés. Surfaces are flat; there is no glass, blur or glow.
keyCharacteristics: One six-step plum ramp for every surface, ground plum-1.
Rose is the single action colour; gold means "live" and nothing else.
Lucide line icons in one muted colour.
Rose heart outlines (never filled) are the recurring motif: app icon, search stage, chat intro, tap bursts.
Every animation is off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Rose Rule
rules.body: Rose is the only action colour. If something is pressable and primary, it is rose with Rose Ink; if it is not, it is not rose.

rules.name: The Gold Means Live Rule
rules.body: Live Gold appears only while a chat is live or a match has locked. It is never decoration and never a second accent.

rules.name: The Plum Selection Rule
rules.body: A selected or current state is a lifted plum fill with a rose icon or rose hairline, never a solid rose fill. Solid rose is reserved for the action itself.

rules.name: The Twelve Pixel Floor Rule
rules.body: No text on a phone is smaller than 12px (0.75rem); tab labels and count badges sit exactly on the floor. Form fields render at 16px on phones so iOS never zooms.

rules.name: The Thumb Reach Rule
rules.body: On a phone the primary action sits at the foot of the screen, full width, directly above the tab bar (Find a Match, Cancel). On desktop it moves up under the content it acts on.

rules.name: The No Scroll To Cancel Rule
rules.body: The search stage sizes itself to screen height (avatar stage capped at 32svh, phrase scaled by svh) so every element, including Cancel, is visible without scrolling.

rules.name: The Quiet Header Rule
rules.body: The header never shows Upgrade and never says "Online". It shows the connection state only when something is wrong ("Connecting..." or "Offline"). Upgrading lives in Profile, the locked tabs and the upgrade sheet. A live chat goes full screen on phones, hiding header and tab bar.

rules.name: The Touch Size Rule
rules.body: On phones, interactive targets are at least 44px (chat-header actions, composer send, profile buttons; tab items are 52px tall; reaction chips 40px within the 44px row).

rules.name: The Step Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: To lift a surface, take one step up the plum ramp. Shadows belong only to overlays; in-flow cards and bars never cast one.

dos: **Do** cut every surface from the plum ramp; lift by stepping one plum step up, not by adding a shadow.
**Do** keep rose for the action and put Rose Ink (#2a0a12) on it.
**Do** show selected and current states as a plum fill with a rose icon or rose hairline.
**Do** reserve Live Gold for a live chat or a locked match.
**Do** use Lucide line icons in one muted colour (Dusk), turning rose only for the current tab or an action.
**Do** draw hearts as rose outlines, never filled.
**Do** keep phone touch targets at 44px and text at 12px or larger.
**Do** make every new animation a one-shot reply to a user action, and switch it off under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: **Don't** use gradients, glass, backdrop blur or glow on any surface.
**Don't** fill a selected or current state with solid rose.
**Don't** use gold as a decorative accent or a second brand colour.
**Don't** bring green or sky into the Match flow as decoration; they are Friends and Discover state colours.
**Don't** add ambient looping motion outside the search stage and the chat intro heart.
**Don't** animate message history; only messages that arrive while the thread is open pop in.
**Don't** put Upgrade or a plain "Online" in the header on any tab.
